source_refs.note: iv) Inter-particle space in solids: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: The interpaticle spaces in solids are far less than liquids. This is due to the stronger forces among their particles. Due to closely packed atoms, molecules, and ions, solids are mostly hard, have high melting points and high stability.
